# `oira_reviews`

One row per OIRA review of a rule under Executive Order 12866, ingested from reginfo.gov's bulk XML exports by `build_oira_reviews`: every review concluded since 1981, plus the reviews still pending at OIRA. EO 12866 review is the mandatory gate a significant rule passes through after the agency drafts it and before it is published, usually once at the proposed stage and again at the final stage. `received_date` to `concluded_date` (`review_days`) is how long the rule sat at OIRA. Keyed by `rin`, so it joins to `unified_agenda.rin` and `federal_register.regulation_id_numbers_json`. There is no primary key: the export carries no review ID, a RIN is usually reviewed more than once, and old files even hold distinct reviews that share RIN, stage, and received date. Rebuilt in full each run. VARCHAR except `review_days`.

- **Parquet file:** `oira_reviews.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rin` | `VARCHAR` | Regulation Identifier Number (e.g. `2060-AV12`). Join key to `unified_agenda` and `federal_register`. Not unique: one row per review, and a RIN is usually reviewed at several stages. |
| `agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Acronym of the agency that owns the RIN (e.g. `OAR`, `CMS`), from reginfo.gov's agency list, matching `unified_agenda.agency_code`. Falls back to the numeric code (the RIN's first four digits) when the agency is not in the list. |
| `agency_name` | `VARCHAR` | Full name of the agency that owns the RIN. Null when the agency is not in reginfo.gov's agency list. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Title of the rule as submitted to OIRA. |
| `stage` | `VARCHAR` | Rulemaking stage reviewed (e.g. `Proposed Rule`, `Final Rule`, `Interim Final Rule`, `Prerule`, `Notice`). Pre-2000 files use some other labels (`Final Rule (N/C)`, `TEMPORARY RULE`). |
| `review_status` | `VARCHAR` | `Concluded` for a review with an outcome, or `Under Review` for one still pending at OIRA on the build date. |
| `received_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date OIRA received the rule for review (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `concluded_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date OIRA concluded review (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`). Null while `Under Review`. |
| `review_days` | `BIGINT` | Calendar days from `received_date` to `concluded_date`: how long the rule sat at OIRA. Null while `Under Review`. |
| `review_outcome` | `VARCHAR` | OIRA's decision, as published (e.g. `Consistent with Change`, `Consistent without Change`, `Withdrawn`, `Statutory or Judicial Deadline`, `Improperly Submitted`). Pre-2000 files use older wording such as `Consistent w/no change` and `Returned (reconsider)`. Null while `Under Review`. |
| `economically_significant` | `VARCHAR` | `Yes`/`No`: whether the rule was designated economically significant (EO 12866 section 3(f)(1)). |
| `major` | `VARCHAR` | `Yes`/`No`: whether the rule is major under the Congressional Review Act. Null in older files. |
| `legal_deadline` | `VARCHAR` | Whether the rule faced a deadline: `None`, `Statutory`, or `Judicial`. |
| `review_extended` | `VARCHAR` | `Yes` when OIRA extended its review period. Rarely populated. |
| `published_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date the rule was published in the Federal Register after review (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`), when reginfo.gov has recorded it. Usually null for recent reviews; reginfo.gov fills it in later. |
| `flags_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON object of the review's other Yes/No flags, keyed by lower-cased tag (e.g. `unfunded_mandates`, `federalism_implications`, `regulatory_flexibility_analysis`, `small_entities_affected`, `homeland_security`, `international_impacts`, `health_care_act`, `dodd_frank_act`, `pandemic_response`, `tcja`). Only flags present in the source file are included; older files have none, so this is null. |
| `source_file` | `VARCHAR` | reginfo.gov export the row came from (e.g. `EO_RULE_COMPLETED_2025.xml`, `EO_RULE_COMPLETED_YTD.xml`, `EO_RULES_UNDER_REVIEW.xml`). |
